headline: Mozambique Mine and Gas Audits Yield $160 Million as Megaproject Revenue Rises
summary: Mozambique's tax authority reported that audits of mining and gas firms uncovered $160 million over nine months as megaproject revenue rose 84%.
why: Resource-rich developing nations rely heavily on tax audits of large extractive megaprojects to boost government revenues and fiscal transparency.

impacts.name: Mozambique
impacts.why: Increased tax collections and megaproject revenues enhance government fiscal inflows.
